'''Nick Miller''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 California State Championship]] on 15 April 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down (no Crush)]], according to Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d545">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-17-mountain-view-ca-4-15-00d545/ mountain-view-ca-4-15-00], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 17 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-17-mountain-view-ca-4-15-00d545/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
